name: Nate Hand Gesture
source: Nate Hand Gesture is a short psychological horror visual novel in which the protagonist is forced to play rock paper scissors with a human-consuming entity named Nate. Her mood influences the outcome of the game, while dialogue choices can lead to multiple endings. The current version contains one main route.
translation: 《内特猜拳》是一部短篇心理恐怖视觉小说，女主角被迫与名叫内特的食人实体进行石头剪刀布的对局。她的心情会左右对局的结果，而对话中的抉择则将导向多种不同结局。当前版本包含一条主线剧情。
